title: goldpass golden-set item
description: One line of a goldpass golden set (JSONL): a question, what the RAG system should do with it, and the evidence it should use.

id.description: Unique, stable identifier. Used to match answers to questions and to compare runs.

question.description: The question sent to the system under test.

expected.description: 'answer' if the corpus supports an answer; 'refuse' if the system should decline.

reference_answer.description: A correct answer, for humans and for judge metrics that need one. Optional.

gold_passage_ids.description: Passage (chunk) ids that support the answer. Retrieval metrics compare retrieved ids with these. Must be empty for 'refuse' items.

source_doc_ids.description: Documents the question is about. Grounding passes only if every cited document is in this list.

tags.description: Free labels for slicing results, lowercase with '-' or '_' (e.g. 'wrong-document' for questions that a similar passage in another document could mislead).

notes.description: Free text for reviewers; ignored by goldpass.

metadata.description: Anything else you want to carry through to the results; ignored by goldpass.
